main_text.p: Dásque adimísque diem mundo, cámpósque iacétes Lampade perpetua lustras: vos sydera, túque Astrorum præses, noctisque argentea Phœbe, Terræ vos, tracstúsque maris, vos alloquar, aures Arrigite, & facilis mundus mea concipe dicta.

Vt ros est tenera longè acceptissimus herba, Fœcundúsque inter geniales irrigat hortos, Et pluuiâ dulci sensim sata læta madescunt, Obducunt rimas limo, atque vligine gaudent, Non aliter nostro effusus stillabit ab ore Versus, & attonitas rapient sacra carmina mentes.
Principium Deus esto, Deus cui vota precésque Concipiam supplex, quem sacris rite litatis Solennes positis genibus venerabor ad aras.
Illius pangam laudes, & nota potentis Facta manus, variis quæ maxima gessit in oris.
Nec solum miranda Deus patrauit, at omni Quæ careant labe, at syncera, innoxia, sanctæ Omnia, more suo, iusti descripsit & æqui Legibus, angusta quas maiestate tuetur.
Immotum loua solium pietásque, fidésque, Et veri, sanctíque ambit, iustíque satelles, Anteuolat lenibus mitis Clementia pennis.

Non igitur vitio affinis, sed criminis expers Iustitiam colit æternam, cui machina mundi Annuit. Heu stirpem indomitâ, populúmque rebelle, Progeniem effrenem, paćtum violasse Tonantis Non pudet, antiquóque à te (ne degener esses)

page.notes: Marginal "Accumu-" is a catchword-like line at the right end of the last line, treated as the paragraph's final word fragment. Text is an italic verse passage, transcribed as stanzas of verse. The long-s/s characters were normalised to plain s. Some letters in the scan are faint; the text is read as printed. The "Accumu-" fragment is a broken word, kept as printed.
